english.title: Remove weapons / ammunition from their place of importation with intent to evade prohibition / restriction
english.standardoffencewording:

(C)_[was concerned in the removal of]_

(D)_[a weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WEAPON..),]_
(E)_[ammunition]_

the importation of which was

(F)_[prohibited]_
(G)_[restricted]_

by virtue of **(..SPECIFY THE ENACTMENT..) from

(H)_[their place of importation]_
(I)_[an approved wharf]_
(J)_[an examination station]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(2)(b), (4) and (5A)(a) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex

libra.complexpenaltydetails: The financial penalty on summary conviction is the prescribed sum or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater
